src: Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement, borehole data (the weekly all-releasable-borehole file, made 2026-11-01): wells by spud date, one per API well number, by month spudded. A spud is reported with some delay, so the series ends with the newest month that ended at least 60 days before; spuds through 2026-08-31. In the 12 months from 2025-09-01 the file shows 101 boreholes spudded: 47 are the first borehole of a well (the wells counted here) and 54 are sidetracks or bypasses of a well, which are not counted.
